users.title: User management
users.desc: Accounts, permissions, staff requests and the activity log

system.title: System management
system.desc: Database and files, backups and restore, and maintenance

appearance.title: Appearance & navigation
appearance.desc: Light or dark mode, and the side menu's style and colors

data.title: Data management
data.desc: Reset data and clear the cache

preview.title: Live preview
preview.text: See how lighting, background and the navigation bar look on your workspace instantly
preview.resetHint: Reset all theme settings to their defaults

theme.title: Lighting & appearance
theme.text: Choose the lighting theme that's easiest on your eyes during work hours

light.title: Light mode
light.desc: Bright backgrounds and eye-friendly colors for clear daytime reading

dark.title: Dark mode
dark.desc: Deep navy backgrounds that save energy and are easy on the eyes in control rooms at night

backgrounds.title: Backgrounds & color gradients
backgrounds.text: Soft color gradients that give your workspace a comfortable depth, with full control over brightness (6 layers)
backgrounds.layersTitle: Six layers (from lightest to slightly deeper)
backgrounds.layersCurrent: Pick the layer that's easiest on your eyes — current:

none.title: Auto
none.desc: Default: a calm background that follows light or dark mode automatically

titanium-slate.title: Titanium Slate
titanium-slate.desc: A calm gray gradient that's easy on the eyes and suits engineering interfaces

petrol-blue.title: Royal Petroleum
petrol-blue.desc: A calm royal blend of royal blue, deep navy and indigo for the energy sector

frost-snow.title: Arctic Frost
frost-snow.desc: A crisp, pure snowy gradient inspired by ice crystals and easy on the eyes

emerald-flow.title: Industrial Emerald
emerald-flow.desc: A modern emerald and teal gradient reflecting efficiency and sustainability

glacier-blue.title: Glacier Blue
glacier-blue.desc: A cool, soft gradient that reduces eye strain during long work sessions

ocean-cyan.title: Cyan Electric
ocean-cyan.desc: A bright, fresh sky-blue gradient that gives the interface a striking clarity

royal-violet.title: Twilight Aurora
royal-violet.desc: A night gradient blending velvet violet and indigo for high visual comfort

sidebar.title: Navigation bar & side menu
sidebar.text: Choose the side menu's style and background color to suit your taste

match-bg.title: Match background
match-bg.desc: The navigation bar automatically takes the background color, gradient and layer you choose

unified.title: Unified auto
unified.desc: The menu color follows the page mode automatically (light by day, navy by night)

navy.title: Dark navy
navy.desc: The standard style for control rooms and the energy sector, with high contrast and classic elegance

light.title: Clean light
light.desc: A pure white standalone menu for a simple, bright design

gradient.title: Royal gradient
gradient.desc: An attractive gradient from deep navy to modern indigo

extras.title: Advanced options
extras.text: Options to refine the look and data density
extras.glassText: A light blur behind cards for better harmony with gradients
extras.densityText: Switch between comfortable and compact layouts

data.title: Factory reset
data.text: Restore the initial default data and clear the cache
